g.data-walk: Riverfront picnics, a playground and the walk to Nicollet Island. About 7 min walk, about 2 min drive.
Open riverfront green that was once a paper mill site. About 8 min walk, about 1 min drive.
Pre K to 5 on 5th Street NE. About 13 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Dinner, cocktails and bowling on Marshall. About 2 min walk, about 1 min drive.
Cabbage rolls, pierogi and house sausage. About 15 min walk, about 2 min drive.
The cheese counter and wine shop on East Hennepin. About 16 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Greek, made by our friend Anna. About 19 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Hot dogs and Chicago style on Broadway. About 18 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Fresh masa and a tasting counter. About 11 min walk, about 2 min drive.
Hmong American brunch and a bakery case. About 13 min walk, about 2 min drive.
